title: Moraine Lake and Lake Louise Sunrise Tour from Banff
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travel time is included in the total duration of the tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our tour provides a unique experience to view the sunrise over Moraine Lake and witness the golden glow light up the mountains. Our experience is also unique in that we take travelers to Lake Louise afterwards, with enough time to walk along the lakeshore, hike to one of the many viewpoints, or canoe on the turquoise water. This experience overall is suited for a variety of travelers, as we provide a lot of time at each lake, so you can make it as relaxed or filled with activity as you'd like - families, solo travelers, nature enthusiasts, etc. With pickups and dropoffs in Banff, and transfers to each lake, visitors to Banff National Park can experience a stress-free way to visit two iconic gems of the Canadian Rockies.
